name: Neural population dynamics during reaching
description: Supervised the conversion of recordings from two 96-channel Utah arrays in the motor and premotor cortex of rhesus monkeys reaching through a maze, combining the raw Blackrock recordings with each session's sorted units, hand, cursor and eye positions, and trial and maze conditions.
Resulted in the publication of a total **53 GB** of electrophysiology and behavioral data on the NIH data archive.
